Leaf heads in the direction of the pub, but stops short at the door. Somehow she thought being in the New World would make this feeling different, but the insecurities still prickle up her back. Maybe tomorrow. Besides, who wants to be inside after being stuck in that sub for so long? For now, Leaf settles for a tree not far from the pub. Her experience finding places to listen but not be seen still holds up, as well as her love for trees. She curls up underneath it and finds that the familiar feeling brings her to sleep faster than any bed could. As she drifts off, she pleads with herself and Melora ||*They're not gone, just lost. Just like you.*||

Baeshra softly strokes Web's head while looking around, not quite tired yet. "We make it Web. Row Kanok. The New World."  She sighs softly, filled with mixed feelings. Excitement about the long voyage finally ending, loss over losing all her possessions, elation about all of her tribe surviving, curious as to what the woods may have to hunt, confusion on the large creature at the beach could it really be Grimmlock, but most importantly love, as he held the person dearest to her in her arms while they slept. She stays awake, watching. Not vigilant, the fears of the past few days are gone. Just watching. As the sky begins to dawn on a new day.

I'm not normally one for sappy thank yous like this. I'll usually think about one bit never write it I or send it. But here goes...
